task: T-249 — a number emitted as a STRING is not rounded, and the census of that shape is the deliverable
leaf: none — a process claim protecting the machine-readable artifact of every leaf
conditions: No physics is computed. Units unchanged and untouched: nm, pN, pN/nm, pN/nm^2 = 1 MPa exactly, k_BT = 4.141947 pN nm at 300 K, aqueous buffer with stated Mg2+. The corpus is gpd/results/ at HEAD of iteration 36 plus this iteration's edits; the baseline every diff is taken against is read out of git rather than out of the working tree.
verificationType: logical — a shape census over the committed corpus, an exhaustive shortest-round-trip test of every hit, a mutation measurement over the predicate in both directions, and 29 named checker + 15 emitter self-tests — plus in-silico: one study re-run through one snapshot and diffed field by field against its committed version

cheapBounds.name: 1 — the artifact-side census, run before any repair
cheapBounds.unit: tokens above nine significant digits inside a string value of a committed result file
cheapBounds.decides: The blast radius is bounded before a single study is re-run. It is 47 files, not one, and 175 distinct emission sites, not three.

cheapBounds.name: 2 — the shortest-round-trip test over every hit
cheapBounds.unit: tokens that are NOT the shortest decimal that round-trips their own double
cheapBounds.decides: The false-positive rate is MEASURED and it is exhaustive rather than sampled: every one of the 757 is exactly what Double.toString() emits, which is the signature of an interpolated Double and not of a transcribed literature value.

cheapBounds.name: 3 — the offline prediction over the one file being repaired
cheapBounds.unit: tokens in 10 string fields predicted to move, with their new values
cheapBounds.decides: What the re-emission must move, and what it must not, before the seventeen-minute solve is spent.

cheapBounds.name: 4 — the reader census against the target
cheapBounds.decides: The re-emission is one file and needs no topological sort. Confirmed twice: tools/result-reader-census.py and a grep of the basename.

cheapBounds.name: 5 — the runbook cost of the residue
cheapBounds.unit: files the shape reaches, 39 dependency constraints between them
cheapBounds.decides: The corpus sweep is a multi-hour, multi-iteration job with a real topological order, so the fourth line ships as an AUDIT and the sweep is queued with its own cost rather than smuggled into this task.

predicates.name: P1
predicates.statement: a shape census over the committed corpus, run before any repair

predicates.name: P2
predicates.statement: the census is a retained tool with self-tests and a MEASURED false-positive rate
predicates.verdict: MET — and the measurement is exhaustive rather than sampled

predicates.name: P3
predicates.statement: the predicate is mutation-tested in BOTH directions
predicates.verdict: MET — ten mutations, every one failing at least one named test, and the widening mutations fail as loudly as the narrowing ones

predicates.name: P4
predicates.statement: the prose is built from rounded values, with digits and floor chosen per CALL SITE, and T-164 re-emitted

predicates.name: P5
predicates.statement: what moved is reported BY KIND against the committed version read out of git, with the staleness identity confirmed and counted

predicates.name: P6
predicates.statement: a decision, with its ground, on whether the census is wired as a gate, and the residue published with its own cost
predicates.verdict: MET — an AUDIT, not a gate, because the corpus reads 757 in 47 and a gate that cannot come clean is not a gate (C-0083)

predicates.name: P7
predicates.statement: every prose number in the re-emitted file equals the file's own numeric field for the same quantity, where the file carries one
predicates.verdict: MET, with one NAMED exception that is a finding rather than a defect — see CH-0198

parameters.predicate: a decimal token inside a STRING value of a result file carrying more than RESULT_SIGNIFICANT_DIGITS significant digits
parameters.guards: (?<![\w.]) refuses a decimal inside an identifier and the tail of a dotted token; (?!\w) refuses a prefix of a longer token; (?!\.\d) refuses the head of a dotted one
